svg.text: GHOSTED: ATS-9000 body map v2, direction B 'Mailbox Bot' + neck (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Rega ts 1795628417.229379: 'B looks cool to me, just need to give it a neck'. Proportions in head-heights, landmarks, attachment points, joins, and a check at the game camera (26 m, pitch 42).
A. FRONT (upright; units: 1 u = 3.73 mm; height 1.25 m)
pink boxes: face zone = the screen (eyes + scan line); mouth = the CV slot.
The neck is a bellows: 3 ink rings on a grey core, 50 u tall (0.56 heads).
B. SIDE (robot's left, the stamp side; front = viewer-left)
stamp swing (dashed): one hinge on the X axis;
head depth +-34 u: a shallow monitor, so the neck shows from above
C. ATTACHMENT POINTS AND JOINS (each one decided; front-view x, y; Z + = front)
screen: inset on the head front (Z 34), x 80-220, y 74-136; eyes 20 x 30 u at x 120 / 180, y 102 (decal / UV)
neck: bellows on the body crown, centred: grey core r 17, y 146-206 (into head and body);
3 INK rings r 26, 8 u tall, at y 155-163, 170-178, 185-193. Fixed (no head turn); optional squash bob
slot (the mouth): ink inset on the body front (Z 50), x 102-198, y 240-254; lip tray under it, Z 44-62
antenna: socket on the head top, robot's RIGHT corner (x 80, Z -16); stalk tilts out to x 66, y 22; gold ball r 10
stamp arm: hub (X axis, r 15) on the robot's LEFT side, y 224, x 212-246; bar x 246-260; block x 242-266;
rubber 8 u ink. ONE hinge. Rest 45 deg (chair call 3), wind-up 140, slam 0 onto the CV
treads: 2 ink belts, x 66-106 and 194-234, y 304-340, Z -58..74; hubs on the OUTER faces only
body: mailbox arch, crown y 200, sides from y 240, hem x 75-225 at y 304, Z +-50
back: 3 vent lines on the head back, a hatch outline on the body back (front and back never mix)
D. PROPORTIONS (1 head-height = head box, 90 u = 336 mm)
total, ground to antenna ball: 334.0 u = 3.71 heads = 1.25 m
body (crown to hem): 104 u = 1.16 heads = 0.39 m
body hem width: 150 u = 1.67 heads = 0.56 m
